prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Selection: Defer user sign-in until after selecting and customizing the pet so users build emotional connection before account creation. (why: The adoption step has high drop-off (60.9%) and sign-in early adds friction before users see the value of having a pet.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Studio Grid: Redesign pet selection into a full visual grid layout with animated previews and immediate trait choices. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off (60.9% conversion, 1017s mean time) and support emails report custom pet generation issues.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Tutorial Screen: Insert a dedicated interactive tutorial screen explaining desktop pet controls, hiding options, and interaction shortcuts before completion. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Mini-Game Flow: Introduce an interactive mini-game screen while background pet generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has high median/mean times (201s / 2336s), causing drop-off while waiting.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Restoration Notice: Add a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging in restores existing pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress & Tips: Show estimated remaining time along with cycling pet care tips during the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s and users suspect the app has stalled or failed.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Time Estimates: Add explicit completion time estimates and path descriptions to the path choice screen. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s (median 8s), suggesting some users get stuck contemplating paths.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Placement Ping Button: Add a prominent 'Locate My Pet' action button on the home welcome screen that pings the pet on the desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not showing up on desktop or app failing to open visually.)

scores.note: Deferring sign-in addresses early friction before users reach the high-dropoff adoption step.

Home step suffers extreme wait times (2336s mean), though building a mini-game is expensive.
Simple copy hint resolving 8 support emails about pet restoration at low implementation cost.
